_comment: Source of truth for the generated LightBurn device profiles.
Edit THIS file, then run tools/build-profiles.ps1. Do not hand-edit profiles/draft/*.lbdev.
DEVICE CLASS: Custom GCode with GCodeFlavor 'wecreat'. LightBurn 2.1.04 detects WeCreat
machines from their banner and warns if you use anything else. WeCreat's own
WeCreat-Lumos-v1.5.lbdev says 'GRBL' - it predates the flavor and now triggers that warning.
SAFETY: no start/end G-code and no macros. The M-code dictionary is now well populated and
several codes are CONFIRMED-vendor, but emitting them FROM LightBurn is still untested.
UNVERIFIED: mirrorX/mirrorY. LightBurn's own wizard defaults both to false for a Custom
GCode device; the older GRBL-class vendor profile used mirrorY true. Determine by framing

profiles.evidence: Working area from WeCreat spec table. All other values inherited from the vendor Lumos profile. UNVERIFIED on an Ultra.
checklist: LENS:     PURPLE field lens installed?          (210 x 210 mm)
SOURCE:   UV (355 nm) selected?
GOGGLES:  190-550 nm UV goggles ON?
FOCUS:    Focus set for this material height?
EXHAUST:  Extraction running? (UV on wood/leather/coated goods)
BED:      Purple lens is for FLAT and CYLINDRICAL work

profiles.displayName: WeCreat Lumos Ultra - UV Green K9 70
profiles.evidence: 70 x 70 mm field from WeCreat spec table (volume 70 x 70 x 135 mm). True K9 internal 3D engraving is not reachable from LightBurn - see docs/09.
checklist: LENS:     GREEN field lens installed?           (70 x 70 mm ONLY)
SOURCE:   UV (355 nm) selected?
GOGGLES:  190-550 nm UV goggles ON?
FIELD:    Artwork fits within 70 x 70 mm?
NOTE:     K9 internal 3D engraving is NOT available from LightBurn.
This profile is for surface / 2D work through the green lens.

profiles.evidence: Separate from the 100W profile so material libraries and checklists stay distinct. Q-Pulse Width and Frequency are NOT available on a GRBL-typed device - see docs/09.
checklist: LENS:     RED field lens installed?             (210 x 210 mm)
SOURCE:   MOPA fiber selected -- NOT UV?
POWER:    This is the 60 W profile. Is this a 60 W machine?
GOGGLES:  800-1100 nm fiber goggles ON?  (UV goggles do NOT protect you)
REFLECT:  Workpiece secured? Specular metal reflects the beam
EXHAUST:  Extraction running?

profiles.evidence: Same geometry as the 60W profile. Kept separate for material libraries and for the power warning in the checklist.
checklist: LENS:     RED field lens installed?             (210 x 210 mm)
SOURCE:   MOPA fiber selected -- NOT UV?
POWER:    *** 100 WATT PROFILE ***  Is this a 100 W machine?
A 60 W machine running 100 W settings will not behave as expected.
GOGGLES:  800-1100 nm fiber goggles ON?  (UV goggles do NOT protect you)
REFLECT:  Workpiece secured? Specular metal reflects the beam
POWER:    First run on this material? START LOW.
EXHAUST:  Extraction running?

profiles.evidence: SPECULATIVE. Working area from WeCreat spec table. Assumes the machine can be told to treat a larger area as its workspace, which is UNPROVEN. LightBurn Split Marking is galvo-only and unavailable here.
checklist: SLIDE:    Slide Extension mounted and clear of obstructions?
TRAVEL:   Full 520 mm travel path clear -- nothing in the carriage's way?
LENS:     Correct field lens for the source in use?
GOGGLES:  Matching wavelength goggles ON?
NOTE:     LightBurn Split Marking is galvo-only and NOT available here.
Slide positioning is manual or macro-driven. Verify before running.
STATUS:   This profile is SPECULATIVE and unverified on hardware.

profiles.evidence: SPECULATIVE. 206 x 206 mm is the Kickstarter FAQ's per-cycle figure; WeCreat's own pages also quote 200 x 500 mm and 1000 x 200 mm. Precedent from the Vision passthrough conveyor is an A-axis feed via LightBurn's rotary setup.
checklist: BELT:     Belt clear, parts seated, load under 10 kg?
FEED:     Feed increment verified on a dry run WITHOUT the beam?
ATTEND:   Batch jobs run long. Do NOT leave unattended.
FIRE:     Extinguisher within reach? Extraction running?
LENS:     Correct field lens?  GOGGLES: matching wavelength ON?
STATUS:   This profile is SPECULATIVE and unverified on hardware.
